summary: Unknown submissions remain paused and are reconciled by hash. A known-failure retry policy gap was found and fixed in source; the original keeper process still runs until a safe approved restart.

finding.unknownSubmissions: No automatic rebroadcast; bounded finalized hash search, persisted progress, and pruned-history pause.
finding.knownFailuresBeforeFix: Automatic backoff/retry did not require explicit nonce reconciliation.
finding.timing: Finalized chain time is captured before each scan batch. Lag can delay execution; it cannot make the deadline check early.

fix.behavior: Submitted known failures and reconciled finalized failures stop in manual-review. Direct failed receipt and dispatch error are retained. Unknown-submission behavior is unchanged.
fix.retryRequirement: Inspect original transaction hash, finalized outcome and system.account.nonce / account_nextIndex before a manually authorized new attempt.

restart.reason: Automatic approval review rejected both the pre-execution stop/start and the later stop/start guarded by a finalized terminal job outcome. Both returned blocked by policy without additional reason. No further stop variants attempted.
restart.currentJobStatus: Job1 terminal Failed after finalized JobExecuted(success=false); no automatic retry of that job.
